- All items are processed at once while Fletching. Stackable fletching items are capped at 10x the regular amount per action. - Chopped logs are automatically burned while Woodcutting granting full Firemaking XP, this effect can be toggled above. You also gain the following benefits to Hunter : - 100% success rate on all actions. - Traps attract animals faster, give double the loot and XP. - Traps always drop a random herb seed or tree seed when harvested. - Hunter rumours give double XP and Hunters' loot sacks will give double the amount of loot rolls. - All loot from jarred implings will give an extra loot roll and be noted. Additionally they will no longer break upon opening. - All Quetzal Whistles will not lose charges.

- All items in shops around Gielinor that use coins as currency are free of charge. - All items purchased from some select shops can be noted, provided the item can be noted at all. - There will be a new button on select shops which toggles this effect. - Shops no longer buy items for gold.

- All non-combat skills are permanently boosted by +12. - The boost from this Relic does not stack with any other weaker boosts but can be overwritten by a stronger one. - When using this Relic, skills that are boosted above +12 will over time drain back to the original +12 boost. - When using this Relic, skills that are drained below +12 will over time restore back to the original +12 boost.

- All non-combat skills are permanently boosted by 10. - Every time you receive an XP drop, gain an additional 2 XP in the same skill. This is affected by the League Passive XP modifier. - For every XP gained, gain 2x as many coins. These can go either to your bank or inventory if there is room, which can be toggled above.

- All of your attacks have 10% increased accuracy and 10% increased damage. - Every 30 seconds, your Special Attack energy is restored by 30% rather than the usual 10%. - Special Attacks that would normally have an energy cost of more than 20% now only cost 20% instead.

- All of your attacks have 10% increased accuracy and 10% increased damage. - Whenever one of your attacks successfully hits, there is a 50% chance that you will restore your Hitpoints and Prayer by 10% of the damage dealt. (Rounded up) - This Relic does not work for multi-target attacks or Special Attacks. - This Relic's restoration effect will work with the Scythe of Vitur's initial hit, however, it will only work for its secondary hits if those hits have the same target as the initial hit.

- All of your attacks have 10% increased accuracy and 10% increased damage. - Whenever one of your attacks successfully hits, up to 5 additional targets next to your opponent will also be hit. The damage dealt to these additional targets will be 100% of the initial damage. - This Relic does not work for multi-target attacks or Special Attacks. - This Relic will only work in a multi-way combat area. - This Relic does not work with the Scythe of Vitur.

- All your attacks have an increased minimum hit (10% of your max hit). - Whenever one of your attacks successfully hits, there is a 50% chance that you will restore your Hitpoints and Prayer by 10% of the damage dealt, rounded up. - This Relic's restore effect does not work for multi-target attacks or Special Attacks. - This Relic's restoration effect will work with the Scythe of Vitur's initial hit, however, it will only work for its secondary hits if those hits have the same target as the initial hit. The Restoration effect will only work on the Venator bow's initial hit.
- Bones dropped by creatures are automatically buried and award 4x XP, this stacks with any existing XP multipliers. - Ensouled heads now drop 2 at a time. - Your prayer drains at 1/2 the speed.

- Changing your offensive prayers before changing gear can provide less pressure on your switches when trying to hit your opponent off prayer. After all, your opponent can't see your offensive prayers! - Use F-Keys to change between your inventory, prayers and spellbook quickly. - Switching gear to increase your damage output is important in fights, but when you're unable to attack, you can further mitigate incoming damage by changing gear to your tankiest equipment until you're free to attack again. - Switching certain pieces of gear to make it look like you're going to do a certain attack style, then swiftly switching gear to a new style is a great way to catch players off guard. If this change of equipment is performed at the same time as you attack your opponent, they will not be able to see the style you are going to attack with, leaving them having to guess which style you will use in the future. - If you don't unequip a staff that has an autocast setting enabled, it can make it significantly easier to attack your opponent while using magic. - The placement of your items in your inventory can have a huge impact. Placing equipment in the same areas in your inventory where you normally access your prayers or special attack can significantly improve your ability to switch. - When you're looking to combine a deadly special attack with the Vengeance spell from the Lunar spellbook, equipping worse defensive gear can benefit you greatly as your opponent is more likely to land an attack on you, making the vengeance recoil damage more likely.
- Colosseum ring of dueling teleport - Bank access in civitas - Fortis Salute emote - Agility shortcut

- Combat skills (Including Hitpoints & Prayer) have a 1.5x Multiplier (Multiplicative with other modifiers). - The "Bigger and badder" slayer unlock is unlocked for free. - Slayer points are x5 from tasks and you aren't required to complete 5 tasks before earning points. - Slayer Superior rates are increased to a 1/50 chance to appear.

- Creatures that drop Clue Scrolls have a 1/15 chance of dropping them. This also applies to Impling Jars. - Clue Geodes, Clue Nests and Clue Bottles are found 10x more often. - All Clue Scrolls have the lowest number of steps possible for their tier. - Every Clue Scroll casket will roll the max amount of rewards it can give. (It can roll the same item more than once) : - Beginner caskets will roll 3 times. - Easy caskets will roll 4 times. - Medium caskets will roll 5 times. - Hard caskets will roll 6 times. - Elite caskets will roll 6 times. - Master caskets will roll 7 times. - There is a chance when opening a clue casket that you will receive another casket of the same tier. This is more common the lower the casket tier. - There is also a chance for this additional casket to be upgraded to a tier above the one you opened.

- Creatures which drop clues now drop them at a 1/10 rate. - Clue geodes, clue nests and clue bottles are now found 10x more often from all skilling activities from which they can be found. - All un-started clues are stackable. - All clues have the lowest number of steps for their tier.
- Damage is increased against monsters by 0.4% per hitpoint you are missing. - Your damage is equal to your max hit on monsters with full hitpoints.
- Defeat Pete to receive 2 vouchers per victory, which can be traded in with Justine.

- Defeat Pete to receive 5 vouchers per victory, which can be traded in with Justine. You will also receive an unlimited supply of ancient fabric, which can be used on any imbued god cape obtained from the Mage Arena II miniquest.

- Ensure you are eating multiple food in one go to survive some otherwise impossible situations. - You will not be able to raise your hitpoints over 99 with Saradomin brews during this challenge. - You will be given unlimited quantities of food and potions. - Complete this challenge to receive 100 Blighted Manta Rays and 50 Blighted Karambwans.

- Every 30 seconds, your Special Attack energy is restored by 30% rather than the usual 10%. - If you have no Special Attack energy remaining, you sacrifice 25 hitpoints for the special attack instead. - Special Attacks are 100% accurate against monsters. - Special Attacks have a minimum hit of 20% of your max hit.

- Farming cycles occur every 1 minute instead of every 5 minutes. (I.e. Your crops grow 5 times faster than normal.) - Resources gathered from Farming are multiplied by 2x. Resources generated this way will not provide any additional experience. - Mixing Potions always results in a 4-dose Potion, and there is a 95% chance to save your secondary ingredient. - Stats boosted above their base level will no longer drain back down over time.
- Improved price for stolen goods - Free herb protection in the Civitas herb patch.

- In PvP combat, prayers reduce damage by 40%. - Look carefully at what equipment your opponent is using and be ready for them to switch. - This challenge grants access to protection prayers, but their usual requirements are: - Protect from Magic: 37 Prayer. - Protect from Missiles: 40 Prayer. - Protect from Melee: 43 Prayer. - Complete this challenge to receive 20 Blighted super restore (4) potions.
- Items from eligible sources will be 5x as common. - Minigame points received are boosted by 8x. - League XP multiplier increased from 8x to 12x.
- League XP multiplier increased from 12x to 16x.
- League XP multiplier increased from 5x to 8x.

- League XP multiplier is 5x. - Items from eligible sources will be 2x as common. - Farming ticks will occur every minute instead of every five minutes. - Minigame points received are boosted by 4x. - Run energy is never drained whilst running. - All clue scrolls will drop as stackable scroll boxes, and clue-step progress is saved between clues.

- Magic spells and weapons with an attack speed of 4 or above have this stat halved, rounded down. - Magic spells and weapons with an attack speed of 3 or below have this stat halved, rounded up. - You save 90% of your Runes when casting spells. This includes charges when using powered staves such as the Trident of the Seas, Trident of the Swamp, Sanguinesti Staff, Tumeken's Shadow, and the Enchanted Slayer Staff. - Bind spells will always hit on an unfrozen, non freeze-immune target. - Acquire the Arcane Grimoire, which allows you to change between any Spellbooks you have unlocked. Must be at a Bank to obtain the item. - Acquire a Rune Pouch. - All Rune Pouches store 2 more types of Runes. - Magic attacks will deal an additional 25% as splash damage to surrounding targets, up to 5 additional targets. - This splash damage effect only works in multicombat areas. - Magic accuracy is increased by 175%. - Magic damage is increased by 20%.

- Melee weapons with attack speed 4 or above have this stat halved, rounded down. - Melee weapons with attack speed 3 or below have this stat halved, rounded up. - 90% of charges are saved when using Melee weapons. - Immune to all status effects, including but not limited to Poison, Venom, and Firebreath, with the exception of stuns and roots. This applies in both PvE and PvP. - 10% Chance to deal a critical strike on a successful melee hit, dealing double damage. - Melee accuracy is increased by 50%. - Melee, Ranged and Magic defence is increased by 50%.

- Once this challenge has been completed, a free training mode is available to practice various combinations of special attacks. You can ask your opponent, nicely, to stop moving or using protection prayers for some great practice sessions. - Ensure you are able to attack your opponent before pulling out your weapon to special attack. Otherwise, your opponent will see your what you're trying to do too early! - Zooming in can make it easier to attack your opponent. - Moving your weapon to the 21st inventory slot and using F-Key to switch to your Combat Options tab can help enable your special attacks quickly. - Adjust your camera so your opponent is close to where you enable your special attack. - Using faster weapons, such as a magic shortbow prior to using a special attack weapon, such as an Armadyl godsword, can help incur high damage on a player within quick succession. - Equipping a weapon that has a special attack will give you instant access to the special attack bar and orb when switching to the weapon you wish to special attack with. - If you cast the Vengeance spell from the Lunar Spellbook, the combined recoil damage with an unsuspecting special attack can be deadly.

- Only a small number of food items ignore the usual eating delay. The most common of these is karambwan. Some potions can also heal you, with these also ignoring the delay. As they're not food themselves, they also don't set the delay, meaning you can use them for a bigger healing combo. - The order of which you eat food or drink potions matters. Shark - Potion - Karambwan. These three actions can all be done in one, if you're quick enough. - Ensure you wait until the damage has hit you before eating. Otherwise, you'll be wasting precious hitpoints that could have been restored. - The Phoenix necklace is not a piece of food, however is an essential item in multi-combat situations. When worn, if your hitpoints drop below 20% of their maximum, the necklace will break, but your hitpoints will be restored by up to 30% and all further pending incoming damage will be cancelled.

- Pete will change equipment quickly. Rather than trying to visually read what he will use, you should try and predict what he will use instead. - As Pete will demonstrate, staying in your highest defensive gear when being attacked is key to reducing incoming damage, in addition to using the correct defensive prayers. - Pete will have access to seeds, but if some flowers are already planted, he will not be able to use them. - Manage your offensive potions well to ensure you have boosted levels for as long as possible. - The Noxious Halberd can be used from 2 tiles away. - Blood barrage is a great way to gain some additional health if your opponent is already frozen and you'd like to use a magic attack.

- Ranged weapons with attack speed 4 or above have this stat halved, rounded down. - Ranged weapons with attack speed 3 or below have this stat halved, rounded up. - 90% of ammunition is saved when using Ranged weapons. This effect stacks with Ava's devices resulting in a 98% ammo saving bonus. Bow of Faerdhinen, Crystal Bow, Chinchompas and Toxic Blowpipe charges are included in this effect. - Enchanted Bolts have a 2x boosted chance to proc. - 10% chance that your weapon will fire an extra projectile. (Bows, Crossbows, Ballista and most thrown weapons). - Ranged accuracy is increased by 100%.

- Switch gear frequently to keep your opponent on their toes. - Use offensive gear that is optimal against your opponent's weakest defences. - Complete this challenge to receive 20 Blighted super restore (4) potions.

- The Grimoire can be used to freely swap between spellbooks. - The Grimoire acts as a Book of the dead. Additionally, when you select this, you will unlock access to all prayers and spells. Regardless of area, quest, or diary requirements.

- The attack speed of all Magic spells and weapons is halved (rounded up). - With +60 Magic Attack Accuracy (or +20 with Regular or Elite Void Knight Mage Armour) your binding and ice spells ignore accuracy checks against creatures. Otherwise, your Magic attacks have 125% increased accuracy against creatures and 50% increased accuracy against other players. - You save 90% of your Runes when casting spells. This includes charges when using powered staves such as the Trident of the Seas, Trident of the Swamp, Sanguinesti Staff and the Enchanted Slayer Staff.

- The attack speed of all Ranged weapons is halved (rounded up). - Your ranged attacks have 100% increased accuracy against creatures and 50% increased accuracy against other players. - Your Ranged attacks deal 10% more damage. - You save 90% of your ammunition when firing Ranged weapons. This does not include chinchompas but does include Crystal Bow, Toxic Blowpipe and Craw's Bow charges.

- The attack speed of all melee weapons is halved (rounded up). - Your melee attacks have 25% increased accuracy. - You take 15% less damage from all sources. - Your Hitpoints regenerate at a rate of 4 Hitpoints per minute instead of 1 Hitpoint per minute.

- The axe is a thrown ranged weapon which can be used to execute targets below 20% hitpoints. - The axe has an attack range of 6 tiles. - The axe's damage respects any ranged damage reduction effects and immunities the target has. - The axe will not work against Yama. - Throwing the axe doesn't consume it, but the primary hit does trigger regeneration effects from Demonic Pacts. - Execute damage can hit additional targets with Demonic Pacts. - This perk will also work inside The Gauntlet.

- The following items no longer consume charges when you teleport with them: Master Scroll Book, Ring of Dueling, Ring of Returning, Games Necklace, Amulet of Glory, Skills Necklace, Combat Bracelet, Digsite Pendant, Necklace of Passage, Slayer Ring and Ring of Wealth. - Upon selecting this Relic you will receive the following items: Ring of Dueling, Ring of Returning, Games Necklace, Skills Necklace, Necklace of Passage and Ring of Wealth. - This Relic cannot be used to teleport to an area you haven't unlocked. - If lost these items cannot be reclaimed from the Sage in Lumbridge. - As this Relic gives you an item it must be unlocked at a Bank.

- This axe will act as a non-degradable variant of the crystal equivalent with no requirements. - When this item is in your inventory or equipped, you gain the following perks: - On failing to chop a tree, you will have a separate 50% chance to succeed. - Items gathered from Woodcutting are automatically sent to your Bank. You will be able to toggle the following effects on or off for the Axe: - Automatically burning logs for Firemaking XP (regardless of your Firemaking level). - Automatically Fletching logs into arrowshafts for Fletching XP (regardless of your Fletching level). Additionally, you gain the following perks to Firemaking : - Never fail to make fires with any logs at any Firemaking level.

- This harpoon will act as a non-degradable variant of the crystal equivalent with no requirements. - When this item is in your inventory or equipped, you gain the following perks: - On failing to fish a spot, you will have a separate 50% chance to succeed. - Items gathered from Fishing are automatically sent to your Bank. - Fish caught have a 50% chance to be automatically cooked, granting Cooking experience regardless of level requirements. - Attempt to catch fish 1 tick faster. - It will also work for fish that don't require a harpoon to be caught, and your harpoon can be substituted as a Net, Big Net, Lobster Pot, or any Rod whilst Fishing. Alongside the Echo harpoon effects you will get the following perks to Hunter : - Hunter catching will never fail. - Box traps catch chinchompas faster. - Chinchompas are doubled when caught, also giving double XP. - Impling jars no longer break upon opening them. Lastly, you never burn food when Cooking.

- This item allows full access to the Managing Miscellania feature from anywhere. - Workers will work for 50% less coins, always have max appeal, produce twice as many resources, and accrue resources every hour instead of every day.

- This item can be used to access the Seed Vault from anywhere in the world. Additionally, you gain the following perks to Farming : - Crops never die. - When planting a seed, it has a 75% chance to not be consumed. - When a seed fully grows, if your Seed Vault has another seed of the same type it will harvest the patch for you, then replant the seed. (Only works whilst online)

- This item can be used to store any single coordinate, alongside your Hitpoints, Prayer and Special Attack Energy, and teleport back to it at a later date, restoring those stats to what they were. - This item ignores wilderness teleport restrictions. - The Crystal of Echoes cannot store coordinates whilst inside an instance. - There are various other locations this item won't store coordinates in, including quest areas, certain minigames, etc.

- This item will allow you to Teleport to any S.T.A.S.H unit and Falo the Bard (Respecting area unlocks). - It has the ability to teleport you to your current clue step, if you have one. Note - this will not work on clue steps that require you to kill a certain NPC. - This item ignores wilderness teleport restrictions. - This item cannot be used to teleport to an area you haven't unlocked.

- This item will allow you to Teleport to any fairy ring, spirit tree, or tool leprechaun. - Unlocking this will autocomplete the Tree Gnome Village quest. - This item ignores wilderness teleport restrictions. - This item cannot be used to teleport to an area you haven't unlocked.

- This item will allow you to note and unnote items anywhere in Gielinor. - You can manually use items on the Banker's Note to unnote or note them all, much like a Bank. - The 'Activate' option allows you to note and unnote items in one action with a specified quantity. An object must first be used on the Banker's Note in order for this to work. - You can customise how many items the Banker's note will note and unnote using the quantity options.

- This item will allow you to summon a powerful Guardian Thrall, lasting 30 minutes. - The guardian will attack your target with whatever style it is weak to. - When you are in multi-combat it will cast an AoE attack if the target is weak to range or magic. - The Guardian's stats are: - Min hit: 5 - Max hit: 13 - Attack Speed: 4 - Accuracy: 45000 - The Guardian does not work in PvP. - This perk will also work inside The Gauntlet.

- This item will allow you to teleport to any Deposit box, Bank, or Bank chest. - This item ignores wilderness teleport restrictions. - This item cannot be used to teleport to an area you haven't unlocked.

- This pickaxe will act as a non-degradable variant of the crystal equivalent with no requirements. - When this item is in your inventory or equipped, you gain the following perks: - On failing to mine a rock, you will have a separate 50% chance to succeed. - Items gathered from Mining are automatically sent to your Bank. - The Echo Pickaxe will cause the rock to not deplete until you have mined 4 ore. - This buff does stack with the existing Mining Gloves, with a cap of 7 ores from a given node. You will be able to toggle the following effects on or off for the Pickaxe: - Collected ores are automatically smelted and grant Smithing XP (regardless of your smithing level). - Gems gathered from Mining are automatically cut and grant Crafting XP regardless of your Crafting level.

- This whistle will allow you to summon a powerful Minion which lasts for 30 minutes. - The minion will attack your target with whatever style it is weakest to. - When you are in multi-combat it will cast an AoE attack if the target is weakest to range or magic. - The minion's stats are: - Min hit: 3 - Max hit: 10 - Attack Speed: 1.8 - Accuracy: 45,000 - The whistle can consume up to 5 unique equippable Zamorak items (by using them on the whistle) increasing your minion's max hit by 2 per unique item. - The minion will try to automatically loot items from creatures you kill (including fired range ammo). A minimum value threshold and whether or not these should be noted is configurable on the whistle. - The minion will deal damage to targets which are immune to thralls. - The minion will not fight in PvP and will not fight against Yama.

- Upon selecting this Relic you will receive a Crystal of Memories which when used will teleport you back to the location from where your most recent teleport occurred. - Your teleport will only be stored if the Crystal of Memories is in your Inventory. You will receive a message in your chatbox if it successfully stored your previous destination. - The Crystal of Memories will not remember your teleport location if you teleport from an instance. - There are various other locations this teleport won't save your teleport location, including quest areas, minigames, etc. - You cannot teleport using the Crystal of Memories whilst you have a follower. - On death, the Crystal of Memories is destroyed and can be reclaimed from the Sage in Lumbridge. - As this Relic gives you an item it must be unlocked at a Bank.

- Upon selecting this Relic you will receive an Extradimensional Bag which will act as a second Inventory with 28 slots. - The Extradimensional Bag can be withdrawn from and deposited into from anywhere. - The Extradimensional Bag can be opened so that items picked up from the ground will automatically go into it. - Items can be withdrawn from a Bank directly into the Extradimensional Bag. - Items cannot be used from within the Extradimensional Bag - they must still be in your Inventory. - Existing storage items such as a Looting Bags, Herb Sacks and Rune Pouches cannot be stored inside the Extradimensional Bag. - On death, the Extradimensional Bag is destroyed and can be reclaimed from the Sage in Lumbridge. The contents of the Extradimensional Bag are not destroyed when this happens. - As this Relic gives you an item it must be unlocked at a Bank.

- Upon selecting this Relic, you will receive a set of Trailblazer Tools which can be used with no requirements. The Pickaxe and Axe will do their respective skilling actions 0.6 seconds quicker than their normal tool equivalent, and the Harpoon increases Fishing speed by 1.2s. All three tools have the same bonuses as Crystal tier tools. - Any ore mined with the Trailblazer Pickaxe will be smelted into a bar, and Smithing XP given, regardless of Smithing level. - Any fish caught with the Trailblazer Harpoon will be cooked, and Cooking XP given, regardless of Cooking level. This will work even for fish that don't require a Harpoon to be caught if the Trailblazer Harpoon is equipped or in your Inventory. - Any logs chopped with the Trailblazer Axe will be burned, and Firemaking XP given, regardless of Firemaking level. - On death, these tools are lost and can be reclaimed from the Sage in Lumbridge. - As this Relic gives you an item it must be unlocked at a Bank.

- Use F-Keys to change between your inventory, prayers and spellbook quickly. - Before a fight starts, ensure you drink your potions and set your offensive and defensive prayers to be prepared in advance for the fight. - When drinking a Saradomin brew, you should drink a super restore potion to restore your lowered levels. The optimal ratio is 3 Saradomin brew sips to 1 super restore potion sip. - Switch your gear to try hit Pete with a style he is not protecting against. - Monitor what equipment Pete is wearing to predict what he will attack with next and change your overhead defensive prayers to counter him. - Use your special attack early in the fight so it has a chance to regenerate. - If you feel overwhelmed during the fight, use ice barrage to freeze Pete and stand under him so you can replenish your health. - Make effective use of your offensive prayers and potions as those are significant buffs to your accuracy and damage.

- Use a binding spell on your opponent to stop them from moving. - After your opponent cannot move, hug a wall, tree, or obstacle to break their line of sight. This prevents them from attacking you and allows you to hop worlds to escape! - Both the Ancient and standard spellbook provide binding spells that can freeze your opponent for a considerable amount of time. These spells are: - Entangle: Level 79 Magic. - Ice Blitz: Level 82 Magic. - Ice Barrage: Level 94 Magic. - Complete this challenge to receive 100 Blighted ancient ice sacks and 100 Blighted Entangle sacks.

- Use a combination of special attacks to help defeat your opponent, such as an Armadyl godsword into the granite maul. - Change weapon and use a special attack against your opponent at the same time to become unpredictable. - Keep your opponent guessing which special attack weapon you're going to use to ensure they can't use protection prayers against that style. - Complete this challenge to receive 20 Blighted super restore (4) potions.

- When doing the following activities, all items are processed at once: - Smelting ores, Smithing bars (does not work with the Superheat item spell) and making Cannonballs. - Fletching logs, stringing Bows and cutting bolt tips. - Making headless arrows, regular arrows, bolts, darts, and javelins (capped at 10x the regular amount per action). - Cleaning herbs and making Potions which do not have a stackable secondary ingredient. - Cooking food and making Jugs of Wine. - Crafting leather, uncut gems, glassblowing, jewellery, pottery, Battlestaves and spinning flax or wool. - Full XP is given for items processed using this Relic. - There is a 25% chance that you will make an extra product, which will be sent to your Bank if you have space. The additional product will also grant XP. - Additionally Crafting, Smithing, Herblore, Fletching and Cooking are boosted by +12.

- When fighting opponents who change their equipment at a rapid pace, you may be better off predicting what they will attack with, rather than basing your prayers on the current gear they are wearing. - Against a less experienced opponent, solely basing your protection prayers on their current gear will likely be optimal. - Wearing your best defensive gear can also reduce incoming damage by making your opponent less likely to hit.

- When getting a Slayer Task, you can choose which Task to receive. The same Task can be chosen repeatedly. - Superior Slayer Creatures have a 1/25 chance of spawning. - Superior Slayer Creatures always drop a Clue Scroll if there is one on their drop table. - Superior Slayer Creatures now have double the number of rolls on the lesser creatures' droptable. This does not double the number of rolls on the Superior Slayer Creature's unique drop table.

- When receiving Slayer tasks you can choose what you are assigned, this allows you to select the same task back-to-back. - When receiving Farming contracts, you can now choose what you are assigned however, you cannot choose the same contract back-to-back.

- When you take fatal damage directly from an NPC or player, you will restore all your hitpoints and Prayer. - Upon triggering this effect you will deal damage to all monsters or players within 3 tiles of you, assuming their south-west coordinate is within this radius. (Similar to how chinchompas and other AoE effects work). This effect will only work in the same scenarios that the Retribution Prayer would normally trigger. - In PvM combat this damage will be equal to 200% of your Prayer level. In PvP combat this effect will be equal to 50% of your Prayer level. - There is a 3 minute cooldown on this effect. - Cooldown is reset on actual death. - The damaging effect will not work on NPCs that are recoil immune, with some exceptions: - Nex - Hespori - Vorkath - All Wilderness bosses

- While equipped, Sage's Greaves will grant Agility XP based on your Agility level while you run. - Completing an Agility course grants two completion count and 25% bonus XP. - 100% success rate on all Agility checks. - Marks of Grace will also spawn with 10,000 coins. - Double Quantity of Pyramid Tops, Hallowed Marks and Agility Vouchers, and Crystal shards (from agility).

- You are able to get a Slayer Task and cancel a Slayer Task by speaking to a Slayer Master or checking your Slayer status via your Slayer Gem, Helmet, or Ring. - Superior Slayer creatures have a 1/25 chance to appear. - Superior Slayer creatures will give Slayer points when killed, based on their Slayer level and difficulty. - Superior Slayer creatures now have double the number of rolls on the lesser creature's drop table. This does not double the amount of rolls on the Superior Slayer Creature's unique drop table. - There is a 25% chance a superior monster will appear as a 'Bloodthirsty' version, with boosted offensive stats. This monster will triple the number of rolls on the lesser creature's non-unique drop table, plus a roll on its own unique drop table. They will also drop guaranteed Clue Scrolls if it is on the superior's drop table. - Expeditious and Slaughter Bracelets will no longer consume charges and have a 35% chance to trigger, up from 25%.

- You can endlessly gather from Fishing spots, Trees and Mining rocks even if they deplete after your initial interaction. - Resources gathered from Fishing, Woodcutting and Mining are multiplied by 2. - XP is granted for all additional resources gathered.

- You receive 2x XP in Smithing, Cooking, Firemaking, Herblore, Fletching, Crafting and Construction. - This stacks with any existing XP multipliers.

- You will harvest patches at a rate of up to 20x per action, noting any contents you receive. - All patches will give 3x the yield. - Farming patches grow instantly. - Your plants will never die. - You have a 20%~ chance to not use a seed or sapling when planting items in patches.

- You will now attack slightly more often with all attack styles! - When attacking with melee, ranged or magic, the delay between your attacks is reduced by 0.6 seconds. This delay will never be less than 0.6 seconds. - Special attacks with instant attacks such as the Granite Maul or Dragon Throwing axes are unaffected.
- You will obtain the Ruinous Powers, a powerful alternate Prayer Book, with all Prayers unlocked. - As this Relic gives you an item it must be unlocked at a Bank.

- Your opponent may use mithril and adamant seeds to slowly move while frozen. This is a technique used in the Wilderness, so always try to use obstacles to your advantage to protect yourself from your opponent planting seeds to move! - If your opponent uses a binding spell to stop you from moving, wait until your freeze is close to expiring before trying to freeze them. Otherwise, you will be frozen at the same time and will not be able to run behind an obstacle! - If you are feeling overwhelmed in a fight, freezing your opponent so you can stand under them or run behind an obstacle is a great way to reset the pace. You can use this time to eat food, drink potions, let your special attack restore or even organise your gear in your inventory. - Some binding spells, such as ice barrage, can be autocast. This can make it easier to catch opponents who are constantly moving. - In multi-combat scenarios, you can freeze opponents and stand under them so they can't attack you while they're frozen. This can help smaller teams beat bigger teams, with the right coordination.
- Your run energy will never drain whilst running. - Your hitpoints restore 4 times as quickly.

The high alchemy and low alchemy spells transform into two new spells: - Alchemic Divergence : Upgrades up to 10 of a resource into a higher tier. - Alchemic Convergence : Downgrades up to 10 of a resource into a lower tier. Both spells cost no runes and have no level requirement. The spell gives 10 Magic XP for each item transmuted (before league XP multipliers). The Transmutation ledger can be equipped and acts as an infinite source of Nature runes. Using items on the Transmutation ledger will display what they can turn into. When cast upon a noted item, these spells will automatically re-cast over time as long as the items are available in the same slot in your inventory. You can still cast alchemy spells via the toggle above or by configuring the spells in your spellbook. Normal Alchemy spells will not automatically re-cast and will only cost 1 Nature rune. List of Transmutable resources: - Hides - Runes - Ashes - Uncut gems - Compost - Seeds (Cactus) - Seeds (Hardwood tree) - Seeds (Fruit tree) - Seeds (Tree) - Seeds (Bush) - Seeds (Hops) - Seeds (Herbs) - Seeds (Flower) - Seeds (Allotment) - Logs (Normal) - Logs (Pyre) - Mining (Normal) - Mining (Crafting) - Bones - Raw Fish

The oak shortbow is a ranged weapon that requires level 5 Ranged to wear. Shortbows fire faster than longbows but are less accurate. Longbows also have the benefit of being able to fire at monsters from a longer range. You use arrows with bows. Most of the time, the better the metal used to make the arrow, the more damage you will hit when using the arrow with your bow. Not all arrows are compatible with each bow, check your Ranged skill guide to find out which arrows your bow can use.

While harvesting any farming crop, or when NPCs would drop bones or ashes, you will instead harvest stackable Soul shards. Soul shards can be used for the following: - They can be used in place of Pure essence while training Runecraft. - 100 can be sacrificed at the Libation bowl at the Teomat for 550 Prayer XP (before league multipliers) without requiring Libation wine. You will receive 1 shard per 4 base Farming XP granted while harvesting or checking health while farming, this is not multiplied by the leagues XP multiplier. You will receive more shards for higher tier bones and ashes roughly equal to the bone shard equivalent for that tier of item.

While on Speedrunning Worlds, you can select a quest to speedrun from your Quest List. Selecting a quest will open the Speedrunning Panel. From there, you can view information on the quest. You can then use the Set Up Speedrun button to teleport to the start point. Doing so will also give you the relevant unlocks and items for the quest. Once you have selected a quest, the speedrun will begin as soon as you start it. This will start a timer that is displayed on your screen. The timer doesn't stop until the quest is complete. Logging out will pause the timer, with it resuming when you next log in. If you're fast enough, you'll unlock a Speedrun Trophy upon quest completion. Each quest has four main trophies to unlock: Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum. The times needed for each trophy are detailed on the Speedrunning Panel. This action also provides a small amount of Herblore XP. - The pouch will only find herbs it has room to store, but will always attempt to give you a herb you can receive. - The pouch also functions as a Silklined herb sack, and shares an inventory with it.
